phase.name: snow
phase.note: biomes are map-wide timed phases: timer message (atl4 type 32) {b: phase, d: ms left}; every phase has its own object layout and creatures (phases below); top-level objects/creatures = phase b

notes.creature_identity: creature field 21 = species (client creature table index, mimic/hosted/creatures.js SPECIES), field 22 = type/element, field 23 = growth stage (0 baby, 1 adult, 2 boss, 3 giant); creature_zones keyed by species (was keyed by field 22 with wrong names before Oct 17)
notes.view: a capture covers his own view while alive and the death spot while dead (the client camera stays there until the next spawn); coverage.view_pct = union of all capture sources, view_pct_base = base only; density, synthetic defs and per-phase spawn use the real objects of all capture sources
